# vastdata_de_pipeline (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lookup by name (requires tenant_name for cluster-admin auth).
data "vastdata_de_pipeline" "by_name" {
  name        = "de-test-pipeline"
  tenant_name = "de-lab"
}

# Lookup by guid.
data "vastdata_de_pipeline" "by_guid" {
  guid        = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  tenant_name = "de-lab"
}

# Lookup by vrn.
data "vastdata_de_pipeline" "by_vrn" {
  vrn         = "vast:dataengine:pipelines:de-test-pipeline"
  tenant_name = "de-lab"
}
```

### Read-Only

- `used_resources` (Map of Set of Object) Per-function-deployment resource usage, keyed by function deployment name. Each value is the list of pod resources for that function deployment (empty when scaled to zero).
